title: Peyton
creator: CrossFit
description: A 20-minute AMRAP of 10 chest-to-bar pull-ups and 10 dumbbell thrusters, interrupted every two minutes (starting at 0:00) by 40 double-unders, followed at the 20-minute mark by a 2-mile run. Honours U.S. Army veteran Chad Robert Peyton, who took his own life in 2021 after struggling with depression. Score AMRAP rounds and the run time separately.
